items.caption: A modern redraw of 友 in small-seal style, with two forms arranged vertically. The seal-script layout illustrates a later arrangement associated with the received graph, while early forms are described as two similarly oriented hand shapes.
items.alt: Black seal-script strokes form 友, with one hand-like shape above another.
items.selection_reason: The supplied pixels show a legible seal-style 友 redraw, and its form is identified as small-seal style. This helps readers compare the vertical seal arrangement with the reported early two-hand forms; it does not document an ancient artifact or establish a literal cooperative scene.

limitations.text: This image is a modern redraw of a received small-seal form, not an ancient inscription. The sources describe earlier oracle-bone and bronze forms as two similarly oriented hands, sometimes joined; this image does not show those forms directly. The precise historical contribution of the two 又 shapes remains disputed, including whether they also cue sound.
